ModMetaData.name: Modmixer Live
ModMetaData.author: Modmixer
ModMetaData.description:
In-game live-modding companion for the Modmixer desktop app.
Prompt the Modmixer agent from a chat window inside RimWorld and watch your ideas land in the running game: hot-loaded C# assemblies, one-shot actions, and def reloads, all over a local connection to the app.
REQUIRES THE MODMIXER APP — this mod does nothing on its own. Get the app free at modmixer.com, then click "Launch Live Session"; it starts RimWorld in a sandboxed test colony with this mod active. Your real saves and mod list are never touched.
